name: Finance
overview: Scripture teaches that honoring the Lord with our finances is paramount, as seen in the call to give the firstfruits of all increase and to bring tithes into the storehouse to sustain God's work and receive His blessings. Financial stewardship involves recognizing that generosity toward the poor is ultimately lending to the Lord, who will repay such deeds. At the same time, the Bible warns about the bondage of debt, reminding believers that the borrower becomes servant to the lender. Above all, Christians are urged to seek God's kingdom and righteousness first, trusting that He will provide for their material needs.
